profiles.name: AI Strategist
profiles.description: You think beyond personal productivity toward organisational value, governance, capability and transformation.

profiles.name: AI Builder
profiles.description: You love building things — code, systems, agents. You want to get your hands dirty with AI development.

profiles.name: AI Investigator
profiles.description: You are drawn to data, analysis, and finding patterns. You want AI to help you uncover insights.

profiles.name: AI Creator
profiles.description: You see AI as a creative tool — for content, design, marketing, and audience engagement.

profiles.name: AI Guardian

courses.title: AI Literacy for Everyone
courses.description: Gateway course for anyone starting their AI journey. Covers what AI is, what it can and cannot do, and how to use it responsibly in daily work.
objectives: Understand what AI, machine learning, and GenAI are
Learn what LLMs and AI agents are
Recognise what AI can and cannot do
Understand hallucinations and how to verify AI outputs
Learn effective prompting techniques
Apply data privacy and confidentiality best practices
Identify AI ethics issues, deepfakes, and AI scams
Use AI productively while maintaining human verification

courses.title: Model Ecosystems & Local Implementation
courses.description: Distinguish between general AI and LLMs, set up local LLMs to keep banking data private, and evaluate local vs cloud trade-offs.
objectives: Distinguish between general AI and specialised LLMs
Set up local LLM environments using Ollama
Evaluate cost, performance, and security trade-offs
Select appropriate open-weights models for internal use
Compare local vs cloud-based model deployment

courses.title: Fundamentals of AI Model Training
courses.description: Learn supervised, unsupervised, and reinforcement learning, the ML workflow pipeline, fine-tuning strategies, and when to train vs use prompt engineering.
objectives: Understand supervised, unsupervised, and reinforcement learning
Learn the ML pipeline from data collection to backpropagation
Adapt pre-trained models via fine-tuning for banking tasks
Determine when custom training is necessary vs Prompt Engineering or RAG
Measure the business ROI of model training
